assessments.reasoning: The first two lines of the pinned project LICENSE directly bind version 3 to the following exception. The attached GPL title also reads “Version 3, 29 June 2007.” The remaining contiguous parts distinguish the generic terms and sample notice from the declaration.

As context, the pinned SPDX detail identifies the same permission and its reference to the GNU General Public License. Its text leaves the edition unspecified. Only the project opening supplies version 3.

challenge.method: Checked the project declaration against GPL section 14 and the “How to Apply These Terms to Your New Programs” example at the end of the same file.
challenge.results: Section 14 makes a later-version option conditional on the program’s declaration. The trailing sample has placeholders and says “any later version.” The project’s own opening names version 3 and contains no such election.

limitations: The finding records the edition expressly named at the supplied 3.4.21 pin. A later-version election, the licensing of other files, and rights in a particular distribution each require additional evidence.
reasoning: The opening expressly says “SQLiteStudio is licensed under the GNU General Public License version 3 with the addition of the following special exception.” This establishes the named GPL edition and its connection to the adjacent permission in the specified LICENSE.
